API.default_unchanged: check_prepared_turn_current(turn_id, *, generation) still opens one new connection and fresh transaction per call
API.scoped: with store.prepared_turn_checker(turn_id, generation=...) as check: check()
API.lifetime: One ordinary audio-production invocation and owner thread; Jobs ExitStack opens on first ordinary reply_sink and closes in _execute finally
API.per_call: Validate DB dev/ino; original live grant lock; BEGIN; unchanged joined snapshot validation; COMMIT. No transaction or validity remains between packets.
API.connection: One URI mode=ro SQLite connection, explicit finite context; no global/persistent pool or stored grant
API.fallback: Store implementations without the scoped API retain their original standalone durable checker; local FSM generating streams and explicit rate-converter path do not acquire a prepared read session

preserved: Per-packet and post-backpressure fresh durable checks
Original live ProfileAccess grant and grant-lock before each transaction
Atomic source invalidation, compaction, TTL, schema and all unrelated Store methods
Original complete plan/hash/samples/token binding and actual complete player ACK
In-memory generation/cancel check under Jobs condition after each durable check before append
bounded_cleanup: Owner is fixed on context creation; foreign enter/call/close rejects before touching SQLite
No retained read transaction during TTS, queue waits or between calls
Check failure rolls back, revokes the session and closes even if a caller catches it
Context-body failure, cancellation, successful production and __enter__ initialization failure close the owned connection
If close itself raises, the revoked session retains the handle for its owner's outer ExitStack cleanup retry
Missing/replaced database or symlink fails closed by dev/ino and regular-file checks; size/mtime changes from legitimate writes are allowed

metadata.guard_thread_cpu_total_ms: Sum of thread_time deltas inside the guard, excluding queue wait and other threads' CPU
metadata.guard_thread_cpu_max_ms: Maximum single guard thread CPU time
metadata.error_policy: Close failure sets phase.complete=false and fixed error_class; no raw exception strings or identifiers are added

covers: One connection across 12 independent read transactions
External clear, per-packet forget/correct/revoke and backpressure checks
Grant lock before each BEGIN and revocation
Jobs success/TTS failure/cancel cleanup and full ACK
Exact original joined validation AST and unrelated Store AST preserved

independent_source_review.result: No authority, lifecycle or unchanged Jobs check-point blocker found

limits: The first connection is initialized once at the first ordinary sink; controller's sentence-level standalone checks remain unchanged
No future playback lease is granted and already emitted/played PCM cannot be retracted
Root alone measures ARM and performs any production publication; these tests do not establish actual listening quality or final performance
